written: 2026-11-20, after SeedLM-11, before any of its coders was trained
motivation: Two runs of the same data mix ended 9 apart on the held-out teacher tasks (s8-all 62, s9-early-last 53; reports/seedlm/seedlm9_protocol.json): every earlier comparison between coders rested on one run each, and its differences (+4 to +10) are of the size of that spread
Held-out sets peak around 30 minutes of training in every coder (SeedLM-8), so shorter runs lose little and allow replication
The claim most worth checking is SeedLM-6's: grafted programs teach composition (s6-graft 61 vs s5-var 52 on held-out teacher tasks, 24 vs 17 on new compositions)
hypothesis: Across seeds, adding grafts raises the held-out teacher tasks solved by the first verified program
design: Two mixes, three seeds each, all trained for 40 minutes (the learning rate decays over the 40 minutes as it did over 120), nothing else running: A = s5-var's mix (scripts/seedlm4_train.py --variant-share 0.1), B = A plus grafts (--graft-share 0.1, the same 15,402 grafts). Seeds 1, 2 and 3 (torch initialisation, data order, synthetic rows, graft descriptions). Runs alternate A1, B1, A2, B2, A3, B3 so an interruption leaves balanced pairs. Names s12-a1 ... s12-b3
primary_measure: held-out teacher tasks (139), first verified program at width 32 correct on all three cases (scripts/seedlm5_fragments.py): supported if B exceeds A by at least 4 on average over the seeds and B exceeds A within every seed pair; not supported if the average difference is 0 or below; inconclusive otherwise
secondary_measures: the same on new compositions (77) and on programs with all pieces seen (62)
the spread between seeds within each mix
held-out development fifth: pyx_model and the best method (scripts/seedlm4_tasks.py holdout)
the vote of the six coders (scripts/seedlm10_ensemble.py) on held-out teacher tasks, against the seven-coder vote of SeedLM-10 (70)
choice: a coder replaces s5-var only if its best method solves more of the held-out development fifth than 69; then the validation gate, one MBPP+ test run and one HumanEval+ run

outcome.primary: held-out teacher tasks, B - A by seed: +1 (60 vs 59), +1 (60 vs 59), -8 (54 vs 62); mean -2.7: not supported

secondary.spread: within A 59 to 62, within B 54 to 60
secondary.held_out_development: pyx_model A 56, 53, 58 and B 59, 55, 56; best method A 68, 68, 68 and B 67, 69, 67

outcome.choice: no coder solves more than 69 of the development fifth: none adopted
outcome.reading: SeedLM-6's graft gain (52 -> 61 on held-out teacher tasks, one 120-minute run each) does not replicate across seeds and is withdrawn. The 40-minute coders (54 to 62) score above the 120-minute s5-var (52), in line with SeedLM-8 and 9
